info.title: Green Tourism Backend API
info.description: REST API for the Green Tourism application. Authentication is session-based and uses HttpOnly cookies (`sessionId`, `accessToken` and `refreshToken`). Register or login to receive the cookies, then send them with requests to protected endpoints.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Registration, login, logout and session refresh

tags.name: Users
tags.description: User profiles, avatars, saved stories and account management

tags.name: Stories
tags.description: Story listing, recommendations, details and creation

sessionId.name: sessionId
sessionId.description: Session identifier cookie set by register, login and refresh.

CategoryQuery.name: category
CategoryQuery.description: Category name used to filter stories.

User.description: User document. The password is always stripped from responses.

PublicUser.description: User document without email and password, as returned by the users list.

avatar.description: Legacy avatar field (the model uses avatarUrl).

img.description: Cloudinary URL of the cover image.

rate.description: Number of users who saved the story.
